resources.string: Ukuqaphela isikrini kuthola izinkinobho, umbhalo nezinye izakhi ezidwetshwa ama-app nemidlalo ngaphandle kokuzenza zifinyeleleke. I-SandFly izibonisa njengezinto ongaswayiphela kuzo futhi uzithephe kabili.
Ukuze uqaphele isikrini samanje, vula imenyu ye-SandFly bese ukhetha okuthi Qaphela isikrini.

Ukuze uqaphele sonke isikrini se-app, vula i-app, vula imenyu ye-SandFly, bese ukhetha okuthi Vula ukuqaphela isikrini. Ukuze ubone ama-app anokuqaphela okuzenzakalelayo, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, SandFly Pro, Ukuqaphela isikrini okuzenzakalelayo.
Ukuqaphela isikrini kuyingxenye ye-SandFly Pro. Ukuze uthenge i-SandFly Pro noma ufake ikhodi, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, SandFly Pro.

Ungakhetha imephu yokhiye yekhibhodi engokoqobo: SandFly, VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS noma Orca. Amamephu okhiye e-VoiceOver, e-NVDA, e-JAWS ne-Orca asebenzisa izinqamuleli zalezo zifundi zesikrini. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, Khetha ukhiye wemephu. Ukuze wenze imephu yokhiye yakho kusukela kweyamanje, khetha okuthi Imephu yokhiye entsha.

Imephu yokhiye ngayinye isebenzisa ukhiye we-SandFly wayo, okungukhiye owubambayo ukuze usebenzise izinqamuleli ze-SandFly. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, Khetha ukhiye weSandFly. Uhlu lubonisa kuphela okhiye abagcina zonke izinqamuleli zemephu yokhiye.
Ungabela izinqamuleli zekhibhodi imiyalo ehlukile ku-app eyodwa. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi kuma-app, bese ukhetha i-app.
Ungabela noma yisiphi isinqamuleli kokuthi Vula noma vala imodi yokubhrawuza, kuhlanganise nokucindezela ukhiye we-SandFly kabili. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Izinqamuleli zekhibhodi.

Amanye ama-app nemidlalo asebenzisa okhiye i-SandFly ebasebenzisa ngaphandle kokhiye we-SandFly, njengokhiye bemicibisholo. Ukuze uthumele lokhu okhiye ku-app yamanje, sebenzisa okuthi Dlulisela okhiye ngaphandle kokhiye we-SandFly kule app. Ukuze uyeke, sebenzisa umyalo futhi.

Okokufundisa kwekhibhodi manje kuyasebenzisana, njengokokufundisa kokuthinta. Ucindezela isinqamuleli ngasinye, bese i-SandFly isihlola. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Usizo nempendulo, Okokufundisa kwe-SandFly, Okokufundisa kwekhibhodi.

Kulawa mamephu okhiye, usebenzisa okhiye njengasekhompyutheni, ngaphandle kokhiye we-SandFly. Umcibisholo waphansi noMcibisholo waphezulu kuya entweni elandelayo noma yangaphambilini. Umcibisholo wangakwesokunxele noMcibisholo wangakwesokudla kuhamba ngohlamvu, futhi i-Ctrl noMcibisholo wangakwesokunxele noma uMcibisholo wangakwesokudla kuhamba ngegama. I-Tab ne-Shift + Tab kuya entweni elandelayo noma yangaphambilini engathola ukugxila. I-Enter yenza into isebenze, futhi i-Escape ibuyela emuva. Enkambini yombhalo, lokhu okhiye bathayipha futhi bahambise ikhesa njengokuvamile.

Ukuzulazula ngezinto kuhamba phakathi kwezinto ngendlela ezifakwe ngayo ngaphakathi kwezinye esikrinini: kuya entweni equkethe into yamanje, kuya entweni yokuqala engaphakathi kuyo, nakwento elandelayo noma yangaphambilini. Imiyalo ikokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukuzulazula ngezinto.

Ngekhesa yokubuyekeza, ungafunda isikrini ngomugqa, ngegama nangohlamvu ngaphandle kokuhambisa ukugxila kwe-SandFly, futhi uchofoze noma uchofoze isikhathi eside lapho kukhona ikhesa. Imiyalo ikokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo, Ukubuyekeza isikrini.

Okuthi Qaphela umbhalo esikrinini kufunda wonke umbhalo osesikrinini, kuhlanganise nombhalo osezithombeni. Sebenzisa ikhesa yokubuyekeza ukuze uhambe embhalweni, bese ucindezela i-Escape ukuze uwuvale.

Ngamaphrofayili okunyakaza, ungashintsha phakathi kwamaqoqo emiyalo yokunyakaza kwakho. Ukuze udale iphrofayili, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Amaphrofayili okunyakaza, bese ukhetha okuthi Engeza iphrofayili yokunyakaza. Ukuze ushintshe iphrofayili, sebenzisa okuthi Iphrofayili yokunyakaza elandelayo noma Iphrofayili yokunyakaza yangaphambilini, isilawuli sokufunda esithi Iphrofayili yokunyakaza, noma imenyu ye-SandFly.
Ungabela ukunyakaza imiyalo ehlukile ku-app eyodwa. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Ukunyakaza kuma-app, bese ukhetha i-app.

Ukuswayipha ngakunye ngomunwe owodwa kunakho nokuswayipha bese ubamba: swayipha, gcina umunwe ungahambi ekugcineni, bese uwuphakamisa. Ungabela umyalo kokunye nokunye kukho kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza. Ukuze ushintshe ukuthi ubamba isikhathi esingakanani, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukunyakaza, Isikhathi sokubamba ngemuva kokuswayipha.
Thepha ukuze uvule izinkinobho zebha yokuzulazula

Ukuze wenze izinkinobho ezisebheni yokuzulazula zisebenze ngokuthepha kanye, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukuthinta, bese uvula okuthi Thepha ukuze uvule izinkinobho zebha yokuzulazula. Leli sethingi lihlukile kokuthi Phakamisa ukuze uvule.
Ungashintsha indlela umbhalo okhulunywa ngayo, kuwo wonke ama-app noma ku-app eyodwa. Iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Isichazamazwi sokukhuluma, bese ukhetha okuthi Engeza okufakwa esikhundleni.

Ama-app angacela ukukhuluma umbhalo ngenkulumo ye-SandFly. Ukuze uvumele noma uvimbe i-app, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Inkulumo, Vumela ezinye izinhlelo zokusebenza zikhulume. I-app yekhibhodi yamanje ingakhuluma ngaphandle kokucela.
Setha kabusha umsindo wokufinyelela ngemva kwamakholi

Ngemva kwekholi, i-Android ingaqhubeka ithumela inkulumo ku-earpiece. Ukuze ubuyisele inkulumo ye-SandFly, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Ukukhipha umsindo, bese uvula okuthi Setha kabusha umsindo wokufinyelela ngemva kwamakholi. Leli sethingi lidinga i-Shizuku.
I-SandFly isebenzisa imisindo emisha, futhi umsindo ngamunye uhambisana nokudlidliza. Ukunyakaza okungenzi lutho kudlala amanothi amabili amafushane ehlayo. Usengashintsha imisindo ngetimu yomsindo.

Okuthi Thayipha igama le-app nge-Braille ukuze uyivule kwenza isikrini sibe yikhibhodi ye-Braille. Thayipha izinhlamvu zokuqala zegama le-app nge-Braille engafinyeziwe. Ukuze uhambe phakathi kwama-app afanayo, swayiphela phansi noma phezulu ngomunwe owodwa. Ukuze uvule i-app, swayiphela phezulu ngeminwe emibili. Ukuze uvale, swayiphela phansi ngeminwe emibili.

Manje ungasebenzisa i-Braille yesiJapanese. Isichazamazwi sesiJapanese siyalandwa okokuqala lapho usisebenzisa. Ukuze ukhethe isiJapanese, iya kokuthi Izilimi kumasethingi ekhibhodi ye-Braille noma kumasethingi esibonisi se-Braille.

Ngesikhathi kuxhunywe ikhibhodi engokoqobo, ikhibhodi ye-Braille iyafihlwa, njengamanye amakhibhodi asesikrinini. Ihlala esikrinini ngesikhathi kuxhunywe isibonisi se-Braille, noma uma okuthi Sebenzisa ikhibhodi esesikrinini kuvuliwe kumasethingi e-Android.
Ukuze wabele le miyalo ukunyakaza noma isinqamuleli sekhibhodi, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Imiyalo.
Ithumela umbhalo osenkambini yombhalo yamanje, ngenkinobho yokuthumela eseduze kwayo noma ngokhiye wesenzo ekhibhodini, njengokuthi Thumela noma Sesha.

Ibala umbhalo owukopishile, omusha kuqala, ukuze uwukopishe futhi noma uwususe. Ngesikhathi i-Shizuku ivumela i-SandFly, umbhalo owukopisha kwamanye ama-app nawo uyengezwa. Amaphasiwedi nomunye umbhalo omakwe njengozwelayo awengezwa. Okuthi Engeza kubhodi yokunamathisela kwengeza umbhalo ngemva kombhalo osuvele usebhodini yokunamathisela.
Ivula noma ivale ukukhuliswa kwesikrini kwe-Android.
Hambela emuva noma phambili kumidiya edlalayo.
Qalisa isinqamuleli sokufinyelela sesinye isici, njengeModi yokufunda. Le miyalo idinga i-Shizuku.
Ithepha isikrini lapho kukhona into yamanje, kwezinto ezingenzi lutho uma i-SandFly izenza zisebenze.
Imisa isaziso i-SandFly esifundayo, nalapho sifundwa ngezwi lephrofayili yezwi.

Iziskripthi manje zingathinta isikrini, zicindezele okhiye, ziqalise imiyalo ye-SandFly, zivule amawindi anemigqa, izihloko namaslayida, ziqaphele umbhalo, futhi zikhulume phakathi namakholi. Ngaphambi kokuthi ufake iskripthi, i-SandFly ibonisa ukuthi sivelaphi nokuthi i-SandFly isisayinile yini.

Amanye amafoni amisa ama-app angemuva ukuze onge ibhethri. Ukuze ugcine i-SandFly isebenza, iya kokuthi Amasethingi, Isibonisi, bese ukhetha okuthi Sebenzisa i-SandFly njengesithombe sangemuva. Ukuze ukhethe isithombe, sebenzisa okuthi Isithombe sangemuva.
